newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman on chip equipment cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman on chip equipment cos.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it reiterated its ratings on several semiconductor equipment companies.
-- reiterated buy ratings on Applied Materials Inc and Teradyne Inc and reiterated outperform rating on KLA-Tencor Corp.
-- said the sector came under pressure on Tuesday as some Wall Street firms expressed concern about summer seasonality and valuation. Lehman said it believes these concerns are overdone.
-- said order data suggests there is little summer seasonality at Applied Materials. Said periodic fluctuations in chip orders do not translate directly to Applied Materials.
-- said believes equipment valuations are low. Although Applied Materials is at a premium to the sector, Lehman said it believes the stock still has room for multiple appreciation.
-- said maintains a one-year price target of $83 on Applied Materials.
-- said KLA-Tencor has a seven-month backlog and can "easily accomodate a seasonal summer bookings pattern, should it occur."
-- said "with the drop in KLA-Tencor's shares, we think the stock is attractive ... and we recommend taking advantage of the current market anomaly."

-- said order activity at Teradyne remains very strong and said it does not expect any summer weakness. Said the dynamics of the test equipment market are "mistakenly assumed to be the same as those for front-end equipment."
-- said Teradeyne's valuation is attractive, "considering the opportunity for upside EPS (earnings per share) surprises in 1997 and 1998."
